Md. Hafizul Alam
Vs.
Mr. Muhammad Enamul Huq and two others
full_judgment: 10. The admitted position is that the communication of the implementation of the Court's order dated 15.3.2000 was made on 23.11.2001) which was not within the period of six months limitation as set by this Court but fact remains that the material part of the judgment that is, constitution of the review committee and consideration of the review application of the petitioner had duly been implemented by the contemner opposite par-ties within the dead line as set up by this Court. Mr. Khan tried to impress upon us that in disposing the review application of the petitioner the review committee did not follow the principles of natural justice in that no opportunity of being heard was given to the petitioner before disposing the review application. We have gone through the judgment of this Court passed in the said writ petition and find that there is no direction given by this Court that in disposing the review application the petitioner should be given a chance of pre hearing. Moreover, it does not fall within the domain of the Review Committee to give a pre-hearing to the petitioner as a review authority. Therefore, we do not find any substance in the submission made by the M. A. Aziz Khan in this regard and since the material part of the Courts order dated 15.3.2000 has been implemented by the Government within the prescribed time set up by this Court we find that the contemner opposite parties have not in any way committed contempt of this Court in implementing this Court's order dated 15.3.2000.
